set.residency_restrictions: For all admitted UAE nationals and children of an Emirati mother or father (NYUAD Scholarships and Financial Aid page, checked 2026-10-30). NYUAD's UAE applicants page words it as "All admitted Emirati students and children of Emirati mothers" — the same group, because a child of an Emirati father is an Emirati national by law (Federal Law No. 17 of 1972, Art. 2).
set.extension_metadata.note: Modeled as a fixed-value Scholarship (100% of tuition + registration fees + study/travel expenses for a defined population), distinct from NYUAD's individualized need-based aid for non-Emirati applicants (CSS Profile), which is not modeled as a Scholarship. Eligible-parent wording reconciled 2026-10-30: src-10 ('UAE nationals and children of an Emirati mother or father') and src-11 ('Emirati students and children of Emirati mothers') describe the same students, since children of Emirati fathers are nationals by law (Federal Law No. 17/1972 Art. 2). Approved by Subhan (full authority) 2026-10-30.

set.academic_criteria: Automatic for offer holders who meet the grades (Appendix B): A-level AAA → 25%, AAB → 20%, ABB → 15%; IB 36 / 34 / 32; AP 5,5,5 / 5,5,4 / 5,4,4. set.other_eligibility_criteria: No separate application — eligible offer holders are awarded automatically and download the letter from NottinghamHub. Applies to the first year of the undergraduate degree only. No nationality restriction stated. (The separate ASEAN International Student Bursary is for ASEAN nationals only.)
